locale.description: BCP 47 locale code, such as en, he, pt-BR or zh-Hant.

name.description: Language autonym or the user's chosen personal translation name.

messages.telegram.title: Telegram
messages.telegram.description: Connect a bot using a named secret from Security settings. Group history is mirrored without granting participants sign-in or AI access.
messages.telegram.serverDisabled: Telegram is disabled in this Server deployment. No Telegram requests are made. Enable it only on your personal installation.
messages.telegram.inputPolicy: Send messages and trigger agents in Telegram. This conversation is read-only in Gromozeka. Only the configured Telegram user can trigger agents; friends' messages are context.
messages.telegram.invalidSettings: Check the numeric Telegram IDs, conversation and agent settings.
messages.telegram.initiator: Telegram user ID allowed to trigger
messages.telegram.writeHint: Uses the same Readonly / Writable instruction as chat. This is guidance to the agent, not a technical write sandbox.
messages.telegram.additionalInstruction: Additional instruction (fixed safety rules always apply)
messages.telegram.overlappingAliases: These trigger substrings overlap. One message may invoke several agents.
messages.telegram.profileGlobal: The bot's profile is shared by every group using this bot. Telegram Bot API does not expose profile accent colors.
messages.telegram.name: Name (up to 64 characters)
messages.telegram.avatarHint: Use an image attachment from a conversation you can read. Telegram requires a square JPEG; transparency is flattened onto a dark background. Leave blank to keep the current avatar.
messages.description: Stable identifiers from the English source catalog. Key completeness and argument signatures are validated against that catalog.

oneOf.description: Cardinal plural forms for the package locale; other is always required. {count} is supplied by the renderer.
